title: UNOWAS–UNOCA qualified factual support
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: V13 is the adopted research reference for selected factual-support obligations. The UNOWAS–UNOCA case covers shared activity across distinct regional reports and briefings; the SP08P1 live-use gate is closed.
testable_mechanism: Ask both owners whether a missing factual-support function causes repeated source reconciliation, qualification loss or missed update propagation; test a source-qualified record only if it improves a named current step.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Reuse the current joint workflow where equivalent functionality exists. If a specific gap is confirmed, trial the smallest owner-approved factual-support control, retaining separate mandated products and clearances.
safeguards: Preserve disputed chronology, source attribution, nested event/attendance distinctions and announcement status
Keep separate regional mandates and product-specific substantive clearance
No live shadow, staff-time capture, product substitution or intervention before both owners approve and activation gates pass
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Three selected joint events, nine appearances and four selected products are a research denominator, not nine separately funded events. Measure total active/review/rework/waiting effort plus setup, maintenance and receiving-office effort; do not equate a shared fact with avoidable travel or cash cost.
minimum_records: Both owners’ approved current-process walkthrough and a specific unmet-control finding
Case-specific owner approval, information-handling rules and frozen expected task/obligation register
Authorized prospective task/update logs, active and waiting time, qualification errors, clearance and final quality
Counterfactual using the current jointly supported workflow and all added control/maintenance effort
custodian_roles_to_confirm: Both offices’ factual-source and clearance custodians

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: Public products demonstrate joint activity and referrals; the internal source-to-clearance workflow has not been reviewed.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Use an existing record system only where a particular factual-support control is missing.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Would the proposed record replace or improve a named step, or simply duplicate a control already operating?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: One owner-approved walk-through per case of a current example: source intake, shared record, update, review and product clearance; a redacted process sketch is sufficient.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing substantive/reporting owners on both sides of each case.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Document equivalent functionality and close the added proposal, or identify a specific missing step and its consequences; silence is not consent.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: Do not claim incremental value or proceed to live shadow without a case-specific gap finding.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: The reports retain 27/28 January visit-start differences; Forum attendance is nested within the visit and is not another field mission.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Keep a common event identity with source-specific date assertions and separate attendance versus event duration.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Does the existing workflow already identify and qualify these differences without repeated reconciliation?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: An approved example of the current chronology/version record and handling of one disputed date; source-custodian explanation only if an exact start is needed.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: UNOWAS and UNOCA factual/reporting custodians, to be nominated by their owners.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Close the proposal if equivalent controls exist; otherwise define the missing qualification rule. Do not choose a start date by majority vote.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: Keep disputed dates qualified; no eliminated travel or verified operational defect claim.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: Joint workshop reporting preserves more than 30 participants and workplan adoption; a best-practice publication is a distinct product.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Reuse attributed workshop facts while separating attendance qualifiers, adopted plans, implementation and publication identity.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Is there a specific repeated preparation or qualification-loss problem not handled by current shared materials?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: A sanitized source-to-fact-sheet example showing roles, attendance comparator, workplan stage and publication link; no attendee list or internal full draft requested.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing workshop/reporting focal points and the publication custodian.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Identify a control gap or retain the current method; do not equate publication with a second workshop or adoption with implementation.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No duplicate workshop, instructor cost, attendance total or productivity claim.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: The later UNOCA briefing explicitly attributes the Niger withdrawal announcement to the earlier UNOWAS briefing.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Use dated assertion versions and receiving-product acknowledgements, preserving announcement status and original attribution.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: How are new facts cleared and propagated today, and would another update record add value?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: An approved update trace showing release, recipient acknowledgement and product-specific acceptance; private timestamps remain in approved storage.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing report and briefing owners in each office.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Record existing control or a specific missed update function. Retain attributed announcement unless evidence supports a later stage.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No completed-withdrawal inference; no assumed publication timestamp or live latency result.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: The reference keeps CNMC capacity, office-specific political assessments and December 2024 context distinct.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Attach selected shared facts to separate analytical products without transferring clearance or moving activities between years.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Which factual-support slice can be isolated while preserving existing legal, analytical and approval responsibilities?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Owner-endorsed task-boundary sketch identifying included support work and excluded analysis, CNMC work, diplomacy and final clearance.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing UNOWAS/UNOCA product owners; relevant CNMC authority for its own boundary only.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Accept a precise support boundary or exclude the component; institutional remit is not inferred from a shared itinerary.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No merged report, altered mandate, synchronized deadline or joint approval chain.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: V10 approval fields remain incomplete; selecting the research reference did not grant institutional authority.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Use the existing decision sheet and local activation record; no new approval mechanism.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Have both owners accepted the specific gap, scope, roles, product deadlines and normal-process fallback?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Case-local authorized decisions and a protected receipt; keep signatures, identities and contacts out of public GitHub.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Authorized representatives of both existing workflows in each case.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Complete authentic local authorization and all V10 requirements under a separate instruction; one case cannot authorize the other.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: Both live gates stay closed. This package records no approval or activation.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: Public research storage is not approved storage for internal drafts, live staff logs or incident narratives.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Use existing approved storage, minimum necessary data and locally controlled pseudonymous records.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: What information, access, retention, staff notice and incident route are authorized for this limited evaluation?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Local records/security determination and approved access/retention arrangements, referenced by non-sensitive receipt only.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Relevant local records, security/privacy authority and measurement custodian.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Document and authenticate the permitted boundary before collection; hashes do not make private content automatically publishable.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No live input collection or external transfer; no upload of sensitive evidence to this repository.

source_snapshot.topic: Prospective scope and comparable quality review
source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: The 61 historical obligations are fixed research items; future live claims and product windows are not yet enrolled.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Predeclare eligible families, matched input waves, language/tasks, exposure and reviewer rubric under V10.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Can each method receive comparable inputs and be judged on the same factual-support duties without carryover or hidden dependence?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Approved future product/claim manifest, source-access timestamps, declared reviewer exposure and both-method task boundary; include failures and pending items.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Both product owners and a locally nominated reviewer/measurement custodian.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Freeze before outcomes; record matched update waves. If parity is not demonstrable, withhold the comparison and retain normal production.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No full-report versus short-fact-sheet comparison; no independent-review or causal-effect claim.

source_snapshot.topic: Effort limits, capture and added burden
source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: No live time or update latency has been measured; V10 sets accounting rules but leaves numerical ceilings and buffers unset.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Use existing empty instruments to distinguish normal, shadow, common, setup and evaluation effort; retain all shifted and failed work.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: What additional burden is permissible, and can comparable task time be captured without estimates or missing work?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Owner-set person-minute ceiling and deadline buffer, expected-task roster, capture procedure and escalation/stop route before any live measurement.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Both workflow owners and local workload custodian.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Set limits prospectively. Missing or estimated time makes complete-process contrasts ineligible; material quality failures preclude advancement despite speed.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No live collection without limits; any later shadow contrast remains descriptive, not labor saved.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: Retrospective source reuse and a future parallel shadow do not establish that an existing work step disappears.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Only later, test replacement of one named step under separately authorized conditions.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Can the step be removed without reducing output quality or transferring concealed work to another team?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Separate approved substitution design, accountable step owner, comparable quality results and observed replacement/shifted effort; not a hypothetical percentage.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing workflow owners and independent/declaration-qualified evaluator as locally approved.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Demonstrate actual displacement and full added burden or do not claim capacity gain. Preserve dissent and failed replacement.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: Not an entry requirement for discussing the proposal; blocks any avoided-labor claim.

source_snapshot.confirmed_basis: No eligible avoidable-cost pool or incremental cash saving is established; overlapping case labels are not separate funded pools.
source_snapshot.proposed_additional_control: Only after substitution evidence, assess cancelable cost objects, added operating costs, transitions and funding boundaries once.
source_snapshot.unresolved_question: Would verified workload displacement release expenditure rather than only create capacity?
source_snapshot.minimum_evidence: Authorized cost-object and cancellation evidence with baseline, transition/operating liabilities and nonadditive allocation; no gross budgets or salary-times-hours shortcut.
source_snapshot.evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Relevant authorized finance/budget owners, only for a later approved assessment.
source_snapshot.closure_rule: Substantiate cash release net of added costs or retain not estimated. Count shared C02/C05/C09 enabling work only once.
source_snapshot.consequence_while_open: No dollar/percentage savings target, post reduction, budget cut or ranking change supported by this package.

case_specific_limit: Historical first-pass holds and separate adopted rechecks are different records; the research reference is not an owner review, fresh full-corpus score or live outcome.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
